provenance.event: Black Friday flash-sale traffic surge: payment provider degrades to partial outage and high latency, catalog pods fail under load, and infrastructure CPU contention affects the Train Ticket station service.
provenance.thought: The steady states require every selected service to preserve its response contract, latency-sensitive edges to stay within timeouts, and availability to remain at declared replica counts with no cascading unavailability. The weakest points are the checkout/payment dependencies: 100% packet loss and 2s latency on payment edges test whether checkout has retries, circuit breakers, and sane deadlines; a product catalog pod kill tests replica/recovery redundancy; CPU stress on ts-station tests resource limits/autoscaling; and latency on client->checkout and checkout->currency tests end-to-end timeout propagation. The order simulates a flash-sale event: first the payment provider drops traffic, then becomes slow and fully burdens checkout, then catalog and infrastructure resource exhaustion appear, and finally cascading latency exposes overall fragility.
